mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate relative to its 5-year moving average signals an easing monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (below 5-year average) and SPX 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate equity market risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts signal a broad-based economic contraction, causing equity market participants to price in recessionary risks and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%), the Federal Reserve is compelled to maintain restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between RSAFS and SPX 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector weakness, prompting immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and elevated federal funds rates signals a recessionary monetary policy environment, causing equity market participants to anticipate earnings deterioration and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE is rising and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market distress (HOUST < 1200 thousand units), the S&P 500 underperforms as equity investors price in sector-wide economic spillovers and reduced consumer confidence, generating negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is below 1200, over any 3-year rolling window.
